items.title: Australia and Jordan shift match from Amman over security worries
items.summary: Australia and Jordan on Friday agreed to move their upcoming friendly from Amman to Doha after players voiced concerns about security. The Socceroos are scheduled to face Qatar in Doha on Friday and were then set to meet Jordan four days later in Amman. But after Australian players expressed worries about travelling to Jordan given tensions in the Mideast, the second match has been relocated.
